recommendation.text: Therefore, the Board recommends that the Administration require missions to ensure the consistent application of the 2018 guidelines of the resource stewardship executive group (ref. 2018.13), in order to efficiently address liquidity management issues. This should be achieved by holding meetings at the required frequency and including all relevant mission uniformed and substantive components, with the finance and budget section/unit acting as secretariat.
